new_files.purpose: Stage 0 multi-recipient v2 consumer: claim/dispatch/ack/result/error with per-recipient locks, capability routing, bounded concurrency (default 2, max 8), DI dispatcher, retry/DLQ, events.ndjson. Skips 3 pre-R320.6 stranded marker files.
Stage 0 operator wrapper for aiosv2.py watch loop. Singleton msvcrt LK_NBLCK lock. Honors AIOS_V2_ROOT override. --once / --max-ticks. Safe nonzero exit on failure.
Stage 0 operator wrapper for v2_consumer. Singleton lock. Honors AIOS_V2_ROOT. --once (in-process tick) / --max-ticks. Safe nonzero exit on failure.

Stage 1 internal bridge: dual-write envelope wrapping, ack+result envelope emission, task_submit/transition/heartbeat/cancel/envelope_send/envelope_receive helpers. Decouples canonical v2 source root (for imports) from AIOS_V2_ROOT (for queue I/O).
Stage 2 chunking tests: 32 KiB split/reassemble, missing/duplicate/mismatched chunks rejected, no_text/small_text returns [].

Stage 0 consumer tests: capabilities advertised, ack/result separate, no-route deadletter, DI dispatcher, dispatcher-exception deadletter, legacy marker files NOT consumed, 4 evidence classes (health/call/trace/handoff), bounded concurrency, stats counters.

Stage 0 idempotency + restart + lease: 6 concurrent identical idempotency writers yield exactly 1 logical message; consumer kill/restart via .claimed.* sidecar recovery; lease expiry reaper; bounded concurrency under tick(); recipient filter.

Stage 2 artifact refs + no-binary tests: artifact_refs[].path/sha256/content_type SSOT, chunk_id/chunk_total/is_chunked additive; validate_envelope accepts chunked envelopes; reassemble round-trip preserves payload; no raw binary anywhere.

Stage 2 task lifecycle tests: submit->running->progress->final (success), cancel from queued, cancel via waiting->cancelled, fail->retry->succeed, retry budget exhaustion, input_request+approval via waiting, heartbeat refreshes lease.
Stage 2 CLI tests: --chunk-size N triggers chunking, no-text -> no chunking, --correlation-id propagates, status shape, init creates state.json.
Stage 0/2 trace tests: events.ndjson completeness for task.submitted / task.transition / task.heartbeat / task.retry / task.cancelled / dispatch.ok / dispatch.retry / dispatch.failed.
Stage 2 MCP bridge tool tests: task_submit/transition/heartbeat/cancel/envelope_send/receive end-to-end via subprocess. Validates required fields, bounds, state machine, invalid envelopes rejected.
